title: Build Reports: Visuals, Formatting, Filtering and Pages

header.html: Select an appropriate visual; Format and configure visuals; Apply and customize a theme; Apply conditional formatting; Apply slicing and filtering; Configure the report page; Choose when to use a paginated report
the official PL-300 study guide (skills measured as of April 20, 2026)

toc.title: Format visuals and apply a theme
The report page and paginated reports

html:
1Choose the right visual

Match the question the viewer asks to the visual that answers it best.

Viewer's question Best visual
Comparison between categories Clustered bar or column chart
Trend over time Line chart or area chart
Part-to-whole, few parts Stacked column, donut or pie chart
Part-to-whole, many parts Treemap
Relationship of two measures Scatter chart (bubble size adds a third)
Single number Card; KPI for value against target; gauge for progress to a goal
Geography Map, filled map or shape map
Detail rows Table, or matrix for row and column groups
Flow and variance Waterfall chart or funnel chart

A waterfall shows a start value rising and falling to an end value. A funnel shows stages that shrink, such as leads to orders. A matrix adds row and column groups with drill and expand; a table is a flat list.

Exam tip

. Waterfall means variance to a total, funnel means shrinking stages, scatter means relationship, KPI means value against a target. Use pie or donut only for a few parts and a treemap for many.

2Format visuals and apply a theme

Fields decide what a visual shows. Format decides how it looks. On the Visualizations pane, the Build visual tab holds the field wells, such as Axis, Legend and Values. The Format visual tab holds appearance. Changing Sum to Average is a field change, not a format change.

Setting Where What it controls
Title General tab Text, font and alignment of the title
Axes Visual tab Show or hide, range, display units, axis title
Data labels Visual tab Values on the marks, units, decimals
Legend Visual tab Series names, position, or off
Colors Visual tab Data color per series or category

A theme is a JSON file that sets colors, fonts and default visual formatting for the whole report. Applying a theme removes report-level customizations you made earlier.

Theme action How
Apply Pick a built-in theme in the Themes gallery on the Design tab
Customize Choose Customize theme to edit colors, text and visual defaults
Import and export Load a theme from a JSON file; Save current theme writes one
Accessible Color-blind friendly and high contrast themes sit in the gallery
Exam tip

. A theme is a JSON file: Customize theme edits it, Save current theme exports it, Import loads it. To meet an accessibility need, start from an accessible theme in the gallery.

3Conditional formatting

Conditional formatting changes a color, bar or icon based on the data. It works on the values of tables and matrices (not on headers). It also works on column and bar charts, cards and button slicers. The types are Background color, Font color, Data bars, Icons and Web URL.

Format style How the color is chosen
Gradient A color scale between a low and a high color, with an optional middle color
Rules If-then conditions on value ranges, one color per rule
Field value A field or measure returns the color: a CSS name, hex code, RGB value, or the theme names good, bad and neutral

Three rules to remember. A text value cannot be colored directly: write a measure that returns the color and use Field value. For percent fields, enter rule values as decimals, such as 0.1, with the type Number. Conditional formatting overrides custom colors set by hand.

Margin Color =
VAR Margin = DIVIDE ( SUM ( Sales[Profit] ), SUM ( Sales[Amount] ) )
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        Margin < 0, "#C0392B",
        Margin < 0.1, "#F5B041",
        "#27AE60"
    )
Exam tip

. Three format styles: Gradient, Rules, Field value. If a measure returns the color, the answer is Field value. If you need a color for text, you need a measure.

4Slicing and filtering

A slicer is a visual on the canvas. A filter lives in the Filters pane. Both narrow the data, but viewers use them differently.

Slicer style Use it for
List or tile Picking one or many categories
Dropdown Long lists in little space
Between, before, after Numeric or date ranges
Relative date Rolling periods such as the last 30 days
Hierarchy Several fields in one slicer, such as Category then Product

The Filters pane has three levels. Filters on this visual affect one visual. Filters on this page affect every visual on the page. Filters on all pages are report-level and affect every page. The filter types are Basic (tick values), Advanced (conditions such as contains or greater than), Top N and Relative date.

A Top N filter keeps the top or bottom number of items by a measure, such as the top 5 products by sales. It stays correct as data changes. A relative date filter keeps a window that moves with today's date, such as the last 3 calendar months.

Slicer Filter in the Filters pane
Where On the canvas, visible In the Filters pane
Scope Its page, or more pages with sync Visual, page or report
Viewer Clicks it as a control Can change it unless the author locks or hides it

A slicer filters every visual on its page unless Edit interactions says otherwise (Module 11).

Exam tip

. Filter levels are visual, page and all pages. Choose a slicer when viewers must see and change the selection on the page, and a filter when the author sets the scope.

5The report page and paginated reports

Page settings sit in the Format page pane and the View tab.

Setting What it does
Page size 16:9, 4:3, Letter, Tooltip or Custom
Canvas background Color or image of the page itself
Wallpaper The area behind the page canvas
Alignment Vertical position of the canvas in the window
Page information Page name, Allow use as tooltip, and Q and A use of the page
Page view Fit to page, Fit to width or Actual size

Page view only changes how you see the page. It does not change the page size.

A paginated report is built for pixel-perfect layout, printing and sharing, and it shows all rows across as many pages as needed. You author it in Power BI Report Builder (free) and save it as an .rdl file. An interactive Power BI report is a .pbix file built for exploration.

Need Choose
Invoices, statements, labels, or every row over many pages Paginated report
Export to PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, CSV, XML or MHTML Paginated report
Slicers, cross-filtering, drillthrough, exploration Power BI report

Viewers on a free license need the paginated report in a workspace on an F64 or P1 capacity.

Exam tip

. Printing, pixel-perfect or all rows across pages means a paginated report in Report Builder (.rdl). Interactive exploration means a Power BI report. Canvas background is the page; wallpaper is behind it.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A finance team needs a visual that shows how an opening balance rises and falls through several expense categories to reach a closing balance. Which visual fits best?

  • AA funnel chart
  • BA waterfall chart
  • CA scatter chart
  • DA ribbon chart
Show the answer

Answer: B. A waterfall chart shows increases and decreases that lead to a total, which the other charts do not.

S2A table shows a text column Status. A measure returns a hex color code for every row, and the author wants each Status cell shaded with that color. Which format style should the author use?

  • AGradient, with a lowest and highest color
  • BRules, with a value range for each color
  • CField value, based on the color measure
  • DData bars, with a positive and negative color
Show the answer

Answer: C. Field value applies colors that a field or measure returns, which is the only way to color text from a calculation.

S3Viewers must pick a product category directly on the report page and see the current selection at a glance. What should the author add?

  • AA visual-level filter in the Filters pane
  • BA slicer visual on the report page canvas
  • CA page-level filter in the Filters pane
  • DA report-level filter in the Filters pane
Show the answer

Answer: B. A slicer is a visual on the canvas, while filters live in the Filters pane.

S4A bar chart must always show the five products with the highest sales, even as the numbers change. What should the author configure?

  • AA basic filter that ticks five product names
  • BAn advanced filter that sets sales above a fixed value
  • CA Top N filter on Product, by the sales measure
  • DA relative date filter on the order date field
Show the answer

Answer: C. A Top N filter re-ranks by the measure whenever the data changes, while the others stay fixed.

S5An author wants a gray area around the report page, while the page itself stays white. Which setting should the author change?

  • AThe wallpaper setting in the Format page pane
  • BThe canvas background in the Format page pane
  • CThe page size setting in the Format page pane
  • DThe page view setting on the View tab ribbon
Show the answer

Answer: A. Wallpaper colors the area behind the canvas, while canvas background colors the page itself.

S6A retailer needs invoices that print the same way every time, with all line items flowing across as many pages as needed. Which report type fits best?

  • AA paginated report built in Report Builder
  • BA Power BI report with a matrix and slicers
  • CA Power BI report with a drillthrough page
  • DA dashboard with tiles pinned from a report
Show the answer

Answer: A. Paginated reports are pixel-perfect for printing and show all rows across pages, unlike interactive reports and dashboards.

6.2 Recall questions

R1What file format does a Power BI theme use?

Show the answer

JSON.

R2What are the three conditional formatting styles?

Show the answer

Gradient, Rules and Field value.

R3Which Filters pane level affects every page?

Show the answer

Filters on all pages (report level).

R4What are the three Page view options?

Show the answer

Fit to page, Fit to width and Actual size.

R5Which filter keeps a rolling window such as the last 30 days?

Show the answer

A relative date filter.

R6Which free tool authors paginated reports, and what is the file type?

Show the answer

Power BI Report Builder, and an .rdl file.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Visual choice Compare: bar; trend: line; relationship: scatter; one number: card or KPI; variance: waterfall; stages: funnel
Format versus fields Fields decide content; Format visual decides look
Theme JSON file; Customize theme, Save current theme, import; accessible themes in the gallery
Conditional formatting Gradient, Rules, Field value; text needs a measure; percent as decimals
Filter levels Visual, page, all pages; Basic, Advanced, Top N, Relative date
Slicer versus filter Slicer on the canvas; filter in the Filters pane
Page settings Size, canvas background, wallpaper, Page information; Page view is zoom only
Paginated report Pixel-perfect, printing, all rows; Report Builder; .rdl
